drafted_from: tools/give-shared-things-readable-names (src/readable-names.mjs claimPublicName and nameFromWords; src/readable-names.json pattern)
start_here: Say to your AI: "Run workflow:claim-a-public-name with store {\"where\": \"postgresql database example_me on my own computer\", \"language\": \"SQL (PostgreSQL)\", \"credential_name\": \"example-me-postgres-connection\"}, claim \"ledger-club\", chosen true and by \"a\"." It holds the name ledger-club for you in your own database, or tells you it is taken.
no_lists_because: It names no list of its own: the public names are held in the person's own store, in whatever form that store keeps them, and store says where and in which language.
instructions: 1. Keep the store's login in your vault under a name you choose, and say where the public names are kept and how the store is spoken to.
2. Say "Run workflow:claim-a-public-name" with store, the name, whether you chose it exactly, the claimant's id and any candidates the tool made.
3. The first run makes the name list once and proves the claims on the example names: every expected outcome and answer must match, or the run stops and says which.
4. Every later run holds the name for its claimant when it is free or theirs, and otherwise refuses it or takes the first free candidate.

worked_examples.title: Hold the name ledger-club for me
worked_examples.ask: Give my club the address ledger-club.

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The look step found the name free; the prove step matched every expected outcome and answer.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "claimed", the name "ledger-club" held by the claimant "a".

worked_examples.title: A name someone else holds is refused
worked_examples.ask: Give my club the address ledger-club, for claimant b.

store.where: postgresql database example_me on my own computer

worked_examples.given: The name ledger-club is already held by the claimant a.
worked_examples.hands_back: outcome "refused" with the reason "taken"; the name is not changed.
